item.title: Cerebral and extra cerebral memory
item.description: In the years 1969 and 1970, Baba gave many amazing demonstrations on different topics related to the laws of spiritual science. One day in 1969, we were with Him at Ranchi. There were just fifteen persons in the room. As we entered the room, Baba said, “Close the door.” We closed the door. Then, He told us, “Everybody should sit in a proper way and keep the backbone straight.” Then, He called four particular persons to the front, close to Him. They were Dada Viirabhadraji, Dada Japanandaji, Dada Vandananandaji, and Sudhanshuji. Three were dadas while one was a Margii. They were all in a line in front of Him. Baba told them to repeat their Ista mantra. He said, “Today I will give a demonstration to show what cerebral and extra-cerebral memory is.”
